historical_control_context.target_roas_condition: Owner confirms the same target ROAS has been used for Max-2 for many years, including the matched WooCommerce and Shopify periods.
historical_control_context.interpretation: The bidding target is not a platform-era confounder. Different budgets, eligible inventory, auction prices, demand, and order mix remain possible explanations for the higher Shopify-era spend.

sample_customer_funnel.source: Owner-provided current operating rates on 2026-07-21, combined with the 2026-05-29 aggregate order-history review for follow-on order value
sample_customer_funnel.ltv_adjusted_roas_formula: (Google-attributed purchase value + sample customers acquired by Max-2 * estimated uncaptured downstream contribution value per sample customer) / Google Ads cost

decision_status: The available data do not establish that the $315/day budget is excessive. Profitability requires Max-2-attributed sample-customer acquisition cost, downstream contribution margin, and a 90-180 day cohort reconciliation.
notes: Google's recommended budget reflects available traffic, not Silk Resource profitability.
The additional-scale comparison is observational because it compares different years and commerce-platform eras.
The recent eight-week break-even margin uses only Google-attributed revenue and therefore understates value when sample customers purchase after the 30-day attribution window.
No campaign-level change event was returned for the target ROAS during June 22 through July 21, 2026.
